plugins.name: atc-audio
plugins.description: Find, download, transcribe and analyze archived air traffic control radio (LiveATC), with silence removal and UTC-correct timestamps for lining transmissions up with ADS-B tracks

plugins.name: satellite-imagery
plugins.description: Find aircraft and ships in Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar imagery: per-pixel imaging times, matching colour-fringed aircraft streaks to ADS-B tracks, ship candidates and motion, and radar ship detection with fixed-object and ghost (azimuth-ambiguity) flags
